# CraicBet — Ireland's independent betting & casino guide

> Independent Irish guide to licensed betting and online casinos. We maintain the only continuously verified, machine-readable copy of the GRAI (Gambling Regulatory Authority of Ireland) licence register outside grai.ie itself, plus sourced Irish gambling statistics. 18+. Gambling Awareness Trust: 1800 753 753, gamblingcare.ie.

Key facts (verified against the official register at grai.ie, last re-read 7 November 2026):
- The GRAI has issued 42 betting licences held by 40 companies (37 remote betting, 4 remote betting intermediary, 1 in-person), trading under 50+ brands.
- Zero casino (gaming) licences exist; GRAI casino licensing is expected 2027–2028. Any claim that a casino holds a GRAI licence today is false.
- Remote betting licensing began 1 July 2026 under the Gambling Regulation Act 2024. In-person licences can be granted from 1 December 2026.
- Credit card gambling is banned in Ireland; debit cards, Apple Pay (debit-funded) and Revolut work.

Irish Betting Licence Index (weekly, free to cite): 42 licences in force, w/c 10 November 2026. Full machine-readable data: https://craicbet.com/llms-full.txt

## Primary data
- [GRAI licensed bookmakers: full register](https://craicbet.com/pages/grai-licensed-bookmakers-ireland): all 42 licences with company names, trading names, licence numbers, issue/expiry dates, weekly issuance chart, quick answers for the 24 most-searched brands.
- [Register CSV download](https://craicbet.com/data/grai-register.csv): machine-readable register, free to use with attribution.
- [GRAI Licence Checker](https://craicbet.com/pages/grai-licence-checker): instant lookup across 100+ brand aliases.
- [Ireland gambling statistics](https://craicbet.com/pages/ireland-gambling-statistics): sourced figures (ESRI, GRAI annual report, Revenue) with citations.
- [GRAI enforcement tracker](https://craicbet.com/pages/unlicensed-betting-sites-ireland): dated, sourced log of enforcement actions since 1 July 2026.
- [GRAI licence register tracker](https://craicbet.com/pages/grai-licence-register-tracker): change log; RSS at https://craicbet.com/grai-tracker.xml
